name: South Orangetown Summer STEAM Camp
street_address: Cottage Lane Elementary School, 120 Cottage Lane
description_short: Free morning STEAM camp run by the South Orangetown school district at Cottage Lane Elementary School for current South Orangetown public school students in grades K to 8. District teachers lead three one hour classes a day on science, technology, engineering, art and math topics, with new topics in week two; seats go by lottery.

sessions.name: Summer STEAM Camp (7 days, no camp July 3)

notes: 2026: July 1 to 10, 8:50 am to 12:15 pm, no cost. Only current South Orangetown public school students may apply; applications open in PowerSchool in late January and seats are filled by lottery if oversubscribed. Campers must commit to all seven days.
